definitions.certified_tour: one immutable artifact hash passes FACT, GEO, TIME, and ENJOY
definitions.algorithm_release: the frozen matrix passes through the certified product entrypoint with no manual prose edits

FACT.materiality_rule: A reasonable listener must be able to treat the wording as a checkable claim about an entity, role, date, number, place, event, act, historical cause, attribution, quotation, ranking, or certainty status.
FACT.licensed_gloss_rule: Recognizable editorial prominence, magnetism, motive, atmosphere, or personification is non-material only when it leaves every checkable underlying entity, act, event, cause, time, place, attribution, quote, and certainty status unchanged.
FACT.precedence_rule: The exact frozen fact-policy calibration cases refine the general taxonomy. They may license colour but can never waive a changed checkable fact.
requirements: each selected material claim has locatable evidence
conflicts are reconciled or uncertainty is preserved
no contradiction, misattribution, or entity truncation
route exact start to first anchor, every anchor leg, and required return leg
store each route shape, seconds, and distance
validate deictic and directional narration against geocoded targets
one stop narrates one place plausibly perceivable from that stop

ENJOY.positive_anchor_policy: all known positive anchors must classify enjoyable even when their old score is 3-5/10

axes.site_presence: uses the actual site, surroundings, observable details, or listener actions
axes.narrative_motion: develops through setup, discovery, consequence, reveal, or payoff
axes.human_specificity: uses people, motives, choices, stakes, and telling particulars
axes.spoken_voice: sounds natural aloud, addresses the listener clearly, and controls rhythm
axes.editorial_control: selects, paces, emphasizes, and transitions intentionally

ENJOY.evidence_rule: every reviewer supplies at least one exact same-item passage for every axis; trusted code validates evidence and computes all totals, comparisons, and decisions

provider_budget.cost_authorization_rule: before call one, trusted code computes and explicitly authorizes the full frozen call plan from its model prices and token ceilings
